required_fixes: POWER: Increase non-304 paired samples to satisfy frozen question and spec POWER requirement: question and spec.json require n_non304 >=800 (spec.json:measurement_validity POWER INCREASE, request.json inherited_next_question). Producer achieves n_paired_samples_testbed=684 non-304 (result.json:metrics.stratified_pooled_n) with n_total=816 total; 132 304s (result.json:metrics.n_304_total, all n_304_valid=132) excluded leaving 684 <800 by 116 samples. At 34 per condition per endpoint, total=816, valid-cache conditions lose 33/34 to 304, so enabled/cache paths are underpowered (run_experiment.py N_SAMPLES_PER_CONDITION_PER_ENDPOINT=34, raw_evidence valid+cache+read+user_profile has304=33). To reach n_non304>=800 accounting for ~16% 304 loss, use >=40 per condition per endpoint with 304-aware allocation or validate after exclusion. Decision_rule MEASUREMENT_INVALID threshold is n<400 so status remains COMPLETE, but the frozen question as stated is not satisfied.

C2 variance reporting: result.json controls C2_variance reports per_endpoint_variance_testbed n=272 for /api/user/profile and /api/data/list (result.json:metrics.per_endpoint_variance_testbed) which includes 304 samples. Spec requires non-304 std>0 (spec.json:falsifier C2, decision_rule C2, spec measurement_validity 304 EXCLUSION). Recompute on non-304 gives profile n=206 std_beh=3.32 std_struct=0.0547, data_list n=206 std_beh=3.32 std_struct=0.0578, session n=272 std_beh=3.5 std_struct=0.0580 (audit recomputed) - still PASS, but report must use non-304 counts to preserve identity.

C7 reporting consistency: spec requires C7 on non-304 endpoint-stratified weighted |r| (spec.json baselines B-PARENT-CONFOUND-V2, spec measurement_validity 304 EXCLUSION). Producer C7 correctly stratified but pan-n metric n_paired_samples_bparent=816 (result.json) includes 304s; per-endpoint bparent n=272 includes 33 304s each for profile/data_list. Non-304 stratified weighted |r|=0.9009 (audit recomputed from raw_evidence bparent_per_condition_data: profile n=206 r=-0.9086, data_list n=206 r=-0.9012, session n=272 r=-0.8948) vs reported total 0.9012 differs negligibly but reporting must be consistent non-304 for ceiling. No effect on PASS but breaks transmission invariant for next-stage comparison.

Claim ceiling wording: producer report.md interprets as CONFIRMED product-consequence positive. Given n shortfall and LOCAL testbed limits, ceiling must be bounded before any VALIDATED/PRODUCT promotion (see claim_ceiling).

claim_ceiling: C-FRESHNESS orthogonality at delta=0.15 SURVIVES on production-like LOCAL testbed (Flask 3.1.3, PyJWT RS256, SQLite WAL-mode, single-node CDN simulation ETag-SHA256/Cache-Control max-age/no-store, 3 endpoints /api/user/profile /api/data/list /api/session/status) with endpoint-stratified pooled r=0.0410 [CI -0.034,0.1156] n_non304=684 (n_total=816), TOST p_upper=0.002, C1-C7 all PASS per frozen decision_rule at delta=0.15, and robust B-PARENT-CONFOUND-V2 negative control |r|~0.90 independent of 304. Ceiling does NOT extend to: (a) n_non304>=800 as required by frozen question (achieved 684, 116 short), so inference at delta=0.10 remains marginal/bounded (TOST p 0.060 at 0.10); (b) distributed production CDN hierarchies, concurrent load, cache invalidation on session change, non-Flask frameworks, or body-inclusive structural signals; (c) headers other than ETag/Cache-Control/request_id entropy. For product, parallel-channel architecture is justified only for this LOCAL production-like regime at delta=0.15; VALIDATED/PRODUCT_CORE not yet warranted pending n>=800 re-run and real-CDN/distributed validation.
